{{Quote|Recently disclosed documents and testimony from a captured Thalassian slaver on Gyndine have implicated four Outer Rim Senators as profiting from slaving ventures in their sectors. Senator Tikkes (Mon Calamari), Senator Bufus Ritsomas (Till Chorios), Senator Danry Ledwellow (Er'kit) and Senator Wuja Wojaine (Pydyr) were all implicated.|A HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN50" />}}
'''Wuja Wojaine''' [[Senator/Legends|represented]] the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Wojaine and other senators were implicated in letting [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] occur in their respective [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], causing their positions to be suspended and their detainment.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The four Senators have had their positions suspended pending trial. They will be detained in their respective embassies on Coruscant until arraignment hearings which are scheduled to begin next week.|A HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN50" />}}
[[File:Pydyr.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wojaine represented Pydyr (pictured) in 22 BBY.]]
Wuja Wojaine was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented<ref name="HNN50" /> [[Pydyr]], an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> in the [[Almak sector/Legends|Almaian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Wojaine received kickback [[Currency/Legends|money]] through letting [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] happen in that [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="HNN50" /> During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]<ref name="HNN50" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #50}} and {{HoloNetNewsWeb|51||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #51}} are set on the dates 13:4:4 and 13:4:11 which correspond to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of [[HoloNet News]] reported that Wojaine&mdash;and fellow Senators [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], [[Bufus Ritsomas]], and [[Danry Ledwellow/Legends|Danry Ledwellow]]&mdash;were implicated in profiting from slavery by a captured [[Unidentified Thalassian slaver|member]] of the [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]] awaiting trial.<ref name="HNN50" /> [[Jurisconsult]] [[Temlet Dodann]] investigated the claims and discovered that the four were receiving money gained from enslavement in their respective sectors and were unaware of each other's involvement.<ref name="HNN50" /> 

Wojaine and the other senators' positions were suspended, pending trial, and were kept in detainment in their embassies on<ref name="HNN50" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] until arraignment hearings scheduled to begin the following [[Standard week/Legends|week]].<ref name="HNN50" /> [[Standard week/Legends|Days]] later,<ref name="Date" /> it was reported that Tikkes had escaped from house arrest and, as a result, security had been increased at the implicated senators' embassies.<ref name="HNN51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_7.html|Senator Tikkes Jumps Bail}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wuja Wojaine was first mentioned in ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 50|HoloNet News Vol. 531 #50]]'', an issue published on the [[in-universe]] [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="HNN50" /> on [[April 4]], [[2002]].<ref name="Date2">{{Hnn|50||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #50}}</ref> Authors [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]] wrote the website's issues.<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
